content:
ops-bot: ALERT — spike in 5xx and latency from routing service in us-west; 12% error rate across HPA pool since 2951234500; possible routing fallback oscillation. Paging oncall: @jin (oncall).
jin: saw it, coming in. initial triage: errors are mostly `model_mismatch` in routing logs. will check recent config push.
alex: @jin I rolled config schema v3 -> v4 at 2951234400, small rename of routing fields (deprecated `preferred_variant` removed). Did we have any compatibility shim? :grimacing:
sara: traffic graphs — latency up to 800ms p95 for text-gen; customer-facing errors increasing. A handful of tenants in APAC also show repeated region failovers.
leo: logs show repeated fallback loop: service tries primary variant -> reports incompatible shape -> switches region -> KV cache mismatch -> route back to primary. looks like variant name mismatch triggers fallback.
maria: that fits with the schema change. v3 defaulted to "primary" when missing, v4 requires explicit `variant_priority`. Missing field = engine picks best-guess variant which isn't always available in some hardware types.
jin: ok, mitigation plan: 1) toggle routing fallback to disabled so we stop cross-region jumps 2) revert schema change OR apply compatibility shim that maps `preferred_variant` -> `variant_priority` 3) identify impacted customers and notify. Anyone object?
alex: no objections. rolling toggle now.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted — PATCH /admin/config/routing/toggles {"fallback.enabled": false} by alex at 2951234570
alex: applied toggle. confirmed: `GET /admin/config/routing/toggles` -> `{"fallback.enabled": false}`
ops-bot: Observability update — error rate dropping to 3% within 30s of toggle, latency p95 down to 250ms. Some residual retries but no region hops observed.
jin: nice. next: apply compatibility shim as safe fix. I'll push a quick mapping in config-service to backfill `variant_priority` when `preferred_variant` exists. PR in flight.
alex: tagging for rollback if anything else: `deploy rollback 2951234400` ready as plan B.
leo: I'm running a query to list all recent routes that used fallback in last 10m: 
```
SELECT customer_id, route_id, region, variant_attempts
FROM routing_events
WHERE event_time >= 2951234400 AND fallback_used = true;
```
leo: preliminary: 42 unique customers, majority on older model families (quantized 4-bit) in us-west and ap-south.
maria: customer impact classification: 7 tenants hit >1% error budget, 3 tenants showed sustained 5xx for >2 minutes. I'll start drafting CX note template.
jin: once shim is up, we should re-enable fallback incrementally for canary region and monitor.
alex: PR merged for shim at 2951234588. compatibility mapping:
```
# config-service pseudo
if routing_config.contains("preferred_variant") and not routing_config.contains("variant_priority"):
  routing_config["variant_priority"] = [ routing_config["preferred_variant"] ]
```
deploy-bot: config-service deploy started by jin at 2951234595
deploy-bot: config-service deploy succeeded at 2951234602
ops-bot: sanity check: replayed 1k failing requests against staging with shim — no fallback hops, variant resolved correctly.
jin: re-enabling fallback for us-west canary at low rate (5%) and watching.
alex: re-enable command: `PATCH /admin/config/routing/toggles {"fallback.enabled": true, "fallback.rate": 0.05}` done at 2951234610
ops-bot: O11y: no new region hops, error rate stable at 2-3%. good.
maria: CX draft: short apology, brief cause (schema rename caused missing variant mapping -> fallback oscillation), mitigation steps taken, remediation timeline, affected tenant list + recommended actions. Sharing in #customer-success after internal review.
leo: post-incident action items: 1) add schema migration guard that rejects breaking removals without compatibility mapping 2) add e2e test that deploys config and simulates missing fields 3) add monitoring alert for repeated region hops per route.
jin: I'm handing off to alex for follow-up; oncall shift ends in 10m. alex, please take over the incident until next handoff.
alex: taking handoff. I'll finalize RCA notes and schedule postmortem meeting. tagging @sara for metrics deep-dive and @maria for CX comms.
sara: I'll extract traces and attach SLO impact numbers. expect preliminary heatmap in 1h.
maria: will prepare customer emails and coordinate support tickets.
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> routing fallback disabled then compatibility shim applied -> canary re-enabled. severity: sev2. Pager cleared at 2951234620. :white_check_mark:
jin: thanks team. logging incident in tracker and scheduling postmortem. main mitigation short-term: compatibility shim + migration guard. longer term: remove deprecated-field silently only after a migration window + automated migration scripts.
alex: posting brief summary to #incidents and linking to this thread for PMs. closing handoff.
